title: A Promise for the Songbook
author: August Halloran
blurb: Mirabel Okafor, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
